_comment: Preview deck for preview_deck.py: one light cover with the logo slot, text, a figure, a four-series chart, a dark divider and a closing slide, so every theme slot shows. Placeholder wording only.

fill.Title: Your colours on a clean deck
fill.Subtitle: Six sample slides that show every colour and font of the theme

fill.Title: Headings use the heading font, text uses the body font
fill.Body 1: Accent 1 carries the emphasis; the brand colours follow it, from dark to light.
fill.Body 2: A wider brand font fills the boxes sooner: the check after the build reports any overflow.
fill.Body 3: Every text and fill pair keeps at least 4.5:1, so the slides stay readable on any screen.

fill.Number caption: the minimum contrast between normal text and the colour behind it
fill.Title: Readable first
fill.Body: Large text and graphics need 3:1. The theme check measures every pair the layouts use.

fill.Title: Chart series follow the accents, strongest first
fill.Subtitle: Four series in theme order

fill.Title: Dark slides
fill.Subtitle: On dark slides the background is accent 1 and the text uses the light colours of the theme

fill.Title: Thank you
fill.Subtitle: The closing slide carries the logo too
